title: Rawafid
description: A multilingual CMS platform for a community, articles, and events, built during a three-month freelance engagement ending October 1, 2026.
imageAlt: Rawafid community platform homepage with flowing connector artwork
architecture: A PHP-based content platform with separate public pages and an admin area. The site organizes community programs, projects, articles, and events; CSS and JavaScript support the responsive, multilingual experience.
highlights: Publish and organize community articles and knowledge content.
Present programs, projects, and events in one community hub.
Manage site content and users through the admin area.
Support multilingual site content and dynamic article categories.

title: Tech Xpress
description: An electronics e-commerce platform focused on a smooth shopping experience, responsive access, and dependable order workflows.
architecture: A full-stack ASP.NET Core MVC application organized into web, data-access, and shared utility projects. Entity Framework supports persistence; repository and unit-of-work patterns structure data access. ASP.NET Identity handles authentication, while Stripe powers checkout.
highlights: Browse electronics through category navigation and product search.
Register, sign in, manage a shopping cart, and place orders.
Complete checkout using Stripe payment integration.
Admin tools manage products and categories.
imageAlt: Tech Xpress storefront with featured electronics and product promotion

title: E-Learning Platform with AI Chatbot
description: A graduation project that helps students explore technology resources, learning paths, books, and instructor content with support from an AI chatbot.
architecture: An ASP.NET Core MVC application using ASP.NET Identity, SQL Server, and Razor views. The AI chatbot adds a conversational way for learners to get help while exploring the platform.
highlights: Explore online learning content, courses, and instructor resources.
Browse learning paths and a book library alongside course content.
Use an AI chatbot for conversational learning assistance.
Completed as a team graduation project and awarded an Excellent project grade.
imageAlt: E-learning platform homepage for online learning and course discovery

title: El Wakeel Law Firm Website
description: A freelance project: a responsive professional website for a legal consultancy, presenting services and giving prospective clients a direct way to get in touch.
architecture: A responsive front-end website built with HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript, with jQuery and Owl Carousel for interactive sections. Formspree handles contact-form submissions.
highlights: Introduce the firm and its legal practice areas.
Showcase the team and client testimonials.
Provide articles, newsletter signup, and direct contact paths.
Responsive layouts present the firm consistently across screen sizes.
imageAlt: El Wakeel law firm website with gold-accented legal service imagery
